content: The American Diabetes Association highlights that anti-VEGF injections have been demonstrated to be effective in the treatment of diabetic macular edema. These injections not only improve visual acuity but also significantly reduce the necessity for laser-based interventions. Panretinal photocoagulation has been proven to be an effective method for preventing severe vision loss in patients with high-risk proliferative diabetic retinopathy (PDR). However, anti-VEGF therapy may provide additional advantages, particularly for patients who prefer or require a less invasive treatment option.
